attempts.architecture: PairwiseTranslationKGE (TransE with L2 distance, entity sphere projection) and RelationalGCN (3-layer R-GCN with 4-basis decomposition and per-layer bias, DistMult decoder)
attempts.augmentations: Pairwise margin hinge loss with margin 1.0, 48 negatives per positive (head and tail corruption), 20% edge dropout in R-GCN encoder, entity L2 normalisation after each TransE gradient step, gradient clipping (max norm 5.0)
attempts.description: TransE: AdamW (lr=1e-3, weight_decay=1e-4) with cosine LR annealing (eta_min=lr/100), 150 epochs, batch 4096, L2 scoring. R-GCN: SGD with momentum=0.9 and linear LR warmup over 10 epochs, 200 epochs, L1 embedding regularisation, 3 propagation layers, 4 shared basis matrices, per-layer bias, Kaiming-normal initialisation.
